name: kettle & stone
notes: not_found: own Squarespace site menu page lists dish/drink names with no prices (only $1 substitute add-on fees appear in the text). allmenus.com and sagemenu.com listings for this restaurant also carry no per-item prices, only a 'Popular Dishes' name list. Multiple independent Yelp reviewers on the sagemenu-mirrored review feed explicitly complain the cafe does not disclose prices on its menu ('I do wish that they would list the prices on their entire menu... I don't understand why they don't disclose it', 'presumptuous that people want to pay $11 for a tiny piece [without] prices on the menu'). No ordering platform (Toast/Square/Clover/etc.) found on the site. Treating as a genuine not-found: a cafe that publishes no per-item prices anywhere.

name: Joycee'S Cocktails
notes: not_found: a Spring Valley dive/sports bar (darts, pool, jukebox, lottery, drink specials since 1989) with no website of its own -- only a Facebook page per the work list. Checked orangebook.com and bippermedia.com directory listings: contact info and hours only, no menu or prices. menupix returned 403. No ordering platform found. Fits the drink-only dive bar not-found pattern -- no per-item prices published anywhere.

name: Winston's Beach Club
notes: not_found: a 21+ live music club/dive bar in Ocean Beach (1921 Bacon St, address confirmed via directory.oceanbeachsandiego.com/go/winstons). Its own site (winstonsob.com, Drupal) has no Menu or Food nav item at all -- only a beer 'On Draft' tap list page, and that page names beers with no prices. Yelp categorizes it as a Music Venue. zmenu.com and menupix.com both 403'd. Search results describe bar food (fries, nachos, burgers, sliders) and a door cover 'like $10 or less' from review text, but no source publishes actual food or drink prices. Fits the drink-only/venue not-found pattern.

name: 3CAT Handcrafted Beverage
notes: Own site (3catea.com, Wix) is fully client-rendered -- no menu data in the server HTML on the homepage or the /categories page, and Snackpass (order.snackpass.co) is likewise a client-side React app with nothing in the initial HTML. DoorDash's marketplace store page (doordash.com/store/3cat-handcrafted-beverage-san-diego-34543843) carries a server-rendered schema.org Menu JSON-LD with 9 sections; excluded a single '3Cat Fridge Magnet' item (a $1,098.90 merchandise entry, clearly not a food price and not a drink) as adjunct/bad data. Ran the markup divisor test (1.04/1.1/1.15/1.2/1.25) against all 49 prices -- none land cleanly on round or half-dollar values, prices carry POS-style odd cents ($6.32, $7.42, $8.52, etc.), so this passes as ungapped/unmarked-up. A prior web search quoted the restaurant's own stated price for 'Mochi Mango' as ~$7.50 with boba (base $6.75 + $0.75 boba); DoorDash's $7.64 for the same drink is within a few percent, consistent with no clean markup. Sibling 3CAT locations exist on DoorDash in LA-area cities but this capture is specific to the 4917 Convoy St, San Diego store id 34543843 (address matches work list).

name: Submarina #2
notes: Work list gives only a Facebook page (facebook.com/submarina2) for this location; found the restaurant on DoorDash's marketplace instead, store id 1803682, address 10645 Tierrasanta Boulevard, San Diego confirmed exactly matching the work list via its schema.org Restaurant block. Extracted the server-rendered schema.org Menu JSON-LD: 2 sections, 'Most Ordered' (12 items) and 'Menu' (79 items). Deduped by exact name+price -- 7 of the 12 'Most Ordered' items were exact duplicates of Menu items and dropped; the other 5 (Macaroni Salad 8oz, Potato Salad 8oz, cookies, a Fountain Drink, and a 6-inch Ham-Turkey-Provolone size not otherwise listed) were genuinely new and kept, folded into Sides/Desserts/Beverages/Menu as appropriate -- so 'Most Ordered' was NOT a pure duplicate sample here, unlike other captures in this batch. Ran the markup divisor test (1.04/1.08/1.1/1.15/1.2/1.25) on all 84 unique prices: best fit 1.1 lands only 14/84 (~17%), in the organic-noise band, not a real markup signal. A WebSearch summary separately quoted specific prices (Grilled Chicken-Provolone 6"/9"/12" and BLT 6"/9") that match this DoorDash capture to the cent, apparently sourced from allmenus.com -- but a direct curl of that allmenus page returned no prices (likely client-rendered), so it could not be independently confirmed and is not cited as crossCheckedAgainst.
